name: Satyr

actions.name: Ram
actions.effect: If the Satyr moved at least 6m toward the target, the target must pass PHYS save or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Enchanting Melody
actions.effect: Plays a magical tune on pipes. All enemies within close range must pass WILL save or be charmed, frightened, or put to sleep (Satyr's choice) for 1 round.

reactions.name: Mirthful Escape
reactions.effect: When an enemy misses the Satyr with an attack, the Satyr can move up to half its speed without provoking reactions.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The Satyr has +1d6 on saves against spells and magical effects.

traits.name: Revelry
traits.desc: Creatures charmed by the Satyr have disadvantage on saves against the Satyr's other abilities.

lore: Satyrs are hedonistic fey who revel in wine, music, and merriment. Their enchanted pipes can bend emotions to their will, turning a battlefield into a dance floor or a campfire gathering into a nightmare.
